# Affordi

> Affordi is a private calculator that converts a price into the work time needed to afford it.

People enter their take home pay, the times and days they work, and currency, then a price that is paid once, every workday, weekly, monthly, or yearly. Affordi shows the work time it takes, when it will have been earned working from now, and its share of take home pay. An earnings page counts what has been earned today in real time, both around the clock and during working hours, shows how much of this month's pay has been worked for, and breaks pay down per second, minute, hour, day, week, month, and year. A fixed costs page lists what is paid every month, such as rent, a mortgage, or loans with an optional first and last payment, and shows their total in work time, as a share of take home pay, what is left each month and per day, and for loans how much is paid and how much is left to pay. A bills page tracks bills that change each month, such as electricity or water, with an amount for each month, and shows the average month in work time, as a share of take home pay, and as a chart of the last twelve months. Calculations, settings, fixed costs, and bills stay in the browser, and no account is required.

## Site

- [Affordi calculator](https://affordi.pages.dev/): Use the calculator in any supported language and install it as a progressive web app.
- [Affordi source and documentation](https://github.com/vladanp/affordi): Review the source code, README, development commands, and release history.
